item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Receipt validation does not reconcile aggregate telemetry with per-call raw counters. An accepted attempt can underreport effective tokens and bypass the mandatory reflection checkpoint despite retaining the true raw counts.
FINDING: high|schemas/factory.execution-receipt-v1.schema.json,scripts/factory-ng-receipt-validate.py|effective_tokens is checked only against aggregate telemetry, while aggregate input/output tokens are never reconciled with model_calls raw counters|this permits silently undercounting a 500k+ attempt and violates raw-counter retention and warning/reflection semantics
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Require aggregate input/output telemetry to equal the sum of available per-call raw counters, propagate unavailable inputs to unavailable effective_tokens, and add invalid fixtures for mismatched and partially unavailable aggregates.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: An accepted receipt has model_calls input_tokens=510000/output_tokens=1, telemetry input_tokens=10/output_tokens=2, effective_tokens=12, status=within_target; the current schema and validator accept it without opening a reflection ticket.
